parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee: <short pause> The Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: <short pause> The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace. <short pause> Numbers, chapter six, verses twenty-four to twenty-six.

Father, bless me and keep me as I sleep. <short pause> Let Your face shine on me with grace. <short pause> Lift Your eyes to me and give me peace. <short pause> I rest in the blessing You speak over me tonight and always. <short pause> Amen.
